evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Clear, bounded CRUD-style functionality with specified inputs; can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Specific mechanism (URL-based access) and scope are clear enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Well-scoped UI behavior with a concrete input control; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: A list/view of session items is a standard, bounded feature; not overly broad.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single, clear interaction (select item) with obvious outcome; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Simple add-to-list behavior; scope is narrow and can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Standard edit operation on an item; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Standard delete operation; clear scope and behavior.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Specific display timing behavior; can be planned and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Concrete computation (average) and action (accept) are clear; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Well-defined condition and outcome; straightforward to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Simple data entry for an estimate; bounded scope.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation within a session is a clear, limited capability; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Underspecified import scope (file formats, mapping, validation, error handling) makes effort hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Vague about expected paste format, parsing rules, and validation; could range from simple text paste to robust spreadsheet-like parsing.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing could imply search, filtering, pagination, sorting, and access control; scope is broad enough to hinder estimation.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game ... see the stories and estimates
evaluations.rationale: A transcript view with specified contents is reasonably bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Specific export format and artifact; can be estimated without excessive ambiguity.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Specific export format; while CSV schema details matter, the scope is still bounded enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Clear delete behavior and affected data; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Concrete fields and action; standard registration feature is estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Standard login behavior; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Too broad: does not specify which details, constraints, or flows (e.g., password change, email verification), making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Clear action and data impact; bounded enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Specific display requirement; implementation approach is standard and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Clear capability (email-based password reminder/reset); bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Two explicit options and clear configuration behavior; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Concrete limit and feature scope; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Clear join flow with specified input; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Simple display of current item; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: A list view of session items is clear and bounded; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Specific UI feedback requirement; scope is narrow enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear reveal condition and behavior; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Well-defined timing constraint for changing an estimate; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Specific data to display (prior estimates per estimator for that story); bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Clear display requirement for current round; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Concrete duration and shared visibility; bounded feature and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear trigger and behavior; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Specific navigation behavior within session history; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Clear consistency requirement for ordering; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Defined condition (draw not completed) and action; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Underspecified source and management of photos (upload, avatars, privacy, storage), making scope potentially large and hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Broad, cross-cutting quality requirement across the whole site; compliance level and scope are hard to bound for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Unbounded scope: 'commonly used terms' is undefined and could expand significantly, hindering estimation.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible
evaluations.rationale: Scope is broad and open-ended ('as fast as possible') and depends on unknown query set and performance targets; difficult to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Cross-cutting compatibility across the entire application is large and hard to bound without specifying which functions/pages are in scope.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Broad and vague ('where possible') across the site; unclear compliance level and scope make estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Non-specific performance requirement without measurable targets or scoped actions; too vague to estimate reliably.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Potentially broad, system-wide requirement (storage, UI, import/export, URLs) without scoping; difficult to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Subjective and underspecified ('sensible', 'predictable') and potentially affects many routes; hard to bound for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Vague and potentially wide-ranging (which errors, which pages, design/content); insufficiently bounded for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Broad and underspecified privacy/anonymization requirement (what data, what transformations, threat model), making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Too vague ('some metrics')—unclear which metrics, time ranges, dashboards/reports—so scope is hard to estimate.
